threads.body:
`to_system_instruction()` consumes `messages` via `list(messages)` inside the `try`, then re-iterates `messages` in the `except`. If the caller passes a one-shot iterator (not a list/tuple) and `convert_to_messages(...)` raises, the fallback will see an exhausted iterator and silently drop all content.

This issue also appears on line 244 of the same file.

replies.body: Thanks! Added `test_system_instructions_absent_from_span_without_content_capture` (parametrized over `NO_CONTENT` / `EVENT_ONLY`) to cover that.

`TelemetryHandler` snapshots content capture at initialization, so modifying the environment via `monkeypatch` after `start_instrumentation` has run has no effect on the handler.

Rhis is already covered by `test_chat_openai_gpt_3_5_turbo_model_llm_call`, which tests all four modes (`NO_CONTENT`, `EVENT_ONLY`, `SPAN_ONLY`, `SPAN_AND_EVENT`) using `instrument(...)` and verifies both span attributes and logs. We can remove this test.
You're right, thanks for pointing it out. Sorry I misunderstood the lifecycle of the handler, I've removed this test
